tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file. Target: relative path starting with WORKING/ (e.g. WORKING/WORKPAPER/datei.md).

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write content to a file. Target: relative path starting with WORKING/ (e.g. WORKING/WORKPAPER/datei.md). Params: {content: str}.

tools.name: append_file
tools.description: Append content to a file. Target: relative path starting with WORKING/ (e.g. WORKING/DIARY/2026-04.md). Params: {content: str}.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List directory contents. Target: relative path starting with WORKING/ (e.g. WORKING/WORKPAPER/).

tools.name: workspace_status
tools.description: Get workspace overview: folders, file counts, active workpapers.

tools.name: query_memory
tools.description: Search LTM for a topic. Target: search query.

tools.name: log_diary
tools.description: Add pointer-only diary entry. Target: summary. Params: {entry: str}.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Analyze content with LLM. Target: content to analyze. Params: {prompt: str}.

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Summarize content with LLM. Target: content to summarize.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List currently loaded LLM models in LM Studio. No params needed.

tools.name: switch_model
tools.description: Switch active LLM model. Unloads current model first (VRAM management). Target: model identifier. Params: {reason: str}. Available: qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct (code/analysis), google/gemma-4-26b-a4b (reasoning/dialog).

tools.name: loop_monitor
tools.description: Run full loop health check. Checks ticks, tokens, format, paths, repetition. Saves report to LOGS/.

tools.name: token_budget
tools.description: Show current token budget limits and usage recommendations.
